Train Joint Multi-Omics Survival Models

Source: R/joint_models.r
train_j_models.Rd

Fits joint multi-omics survival models (CoopCox, AFTCoop, or blockForest) on two or more omics layers from a training MultiAssayExperiment. Survival outcome (overall_survival and status) is extracted directly from colData(mae_train). Results are stored in the returned MAE.

Usage

train_j_models(
  mae_train,
  omic_list,
  joint_method = c("CoopCox", "AFTCoop", "blockForest"),
  seed = 123,
  ...
)

Arguments

mae_train

A MultiAssayExperiment built with build_MAE. colData must contain "overall_survival" and "status".

omic_list

Character vector of assay names to use (e.g. c("mRNA", "CNV")). Order matters for "AFTCoop" (exactly 2 omics required).

joint_method

Character string: "CoopCox" (2-3 omics), "AFTCoop" (exactly 2 omics), or "blockForest" (any number).

seed

Integer seed. Default is 123.

...

Additional arguments passed to the underlying train function:

  • CoopCox: val_fraction, lambdaVector, folds, alpha, maxit.

  • AFTCoop: model, rho_values, ncore_max_rho, ncore_max_cv.

  • blockForest: threads, always.split.variables, n_top_features.

Value

mae_train with results stored at metadata(mae_train)$analysis$joint[[joint_method]], containing train and metrics (resubstitution Harrell C-index).

See also

predict_j_models, train_cooplearning, train_AFTCoop, train_blockForest
